scientific_integrity: Exact distributional, integral and gap-identity proofs in RESULT.md; standalone code supplies finite diagnostics, not universal proof. Originality is based on actual primary literature and research-record comparisons; historical priority is not exhaustively certified.
scientific_limitations: Odd n>=3, positive width, independent Haar-uniform common-center rotations. The exact finite configuration Hausdorff identity is only asserted when the largest phase gap is below half the rotation period. Fixed-n and fixed-m limits are separate; no joint-limit independence or uniform Hausdorff-rate claims are made.
title: Random rotational hulls of regular Reuleaux polygons: exact perimeter and Gumbel covering
